title: image-projection-request
description: Typed input for the geo-to-image-pixels capability: registered affine projection of ordered stops and route lines onto the original basemap image. All references are digest-bound; the handler resolves and re-verifies bytes before projecting.

image_ref.description: Basemap image (8-bit PNG); digest is the byte-level file digest.

parameters_ref.description: Registration parameters document; digest is the canonical JSON digest.

stops_ref.description: Prepared route-stops FeatureCollection; digest is the canonical JSON digest.

route_ref.description: Optional prepared route-line FeatureCollection; omitted means no route geometry.
